snippet.title: Clicker Climber Pachinko // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3665640/Clicker_Climber_Pachinko

Earn a quadrillion dollars before time expires in this intense strategy game. Click pachinko balls and get paid when they bounce or when they land in multiplier slots at the top of each level. Pause and plan before buying payout upgrades, and consider how each purchase changes the other prices.

Developed by
Bergeronimo
